title: An Oxide Ion Encapsulating Tetraholmium Tetrahedron Stabilized by Complexation with the “Carbons Apart” C2B4-Carborane Ligands

material_class.structural_family: μ4-oxo tetraholmium tetrahedron with carbons-apart C2B4-carborane ligands

synthesis.procedure: Anhydrous HoCl3 was first treated with freshly distilled water under reflux in THF until a homogeneous THF solution was obtained. A THF solution of closo-exo-5,6-Na(THF)2-1-Na(THF)2-2,4-(SiMe3)2-2,4-C2B4H4 (1) was then poured in vacuo onto the holmium chloride solution at −78 °C to give an overall 1:HoCl3:H2O mole ratio of 5:4:1. The mixture was refluxed overnight with constant stirring to afford the oxoholmacarborane 2 as a pale yellow crystalline solid. Direct addition of HoCl3 and water to a solution of 1 without prior refluxing caused rapid carborane decomposition at room temperature.
synthesis.temperature: HoCl3/H2O refluxed in THF to homogeneity; ligand addition at −78 °C; then reflux overnight
synthesis.vessel_or_method: THF reflux of HoCl3/H2O, then in vacuo addition of the carborane solution at −78 °C followed by overnight reflux with stirring
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated as a pale yellow crystalline solid; X-ray structure includes two lattice THF molecules.

properties.summary: Compound 2 is paramagnetic with μeff = 10.3 μB, close to Ho2(SO4)3·8H2O (10.4 μB) and the theoretical 10.6 μB, consistent with Ho(III) (5I8).

measurements.name: effective magnetic moment (μeff)
measurements.conditions: compound 2; compared with 10.4 μB for Ho2(SO4)3·8H2O and theoretical 10.6 μB
